title: Understanding the Scatterplot
text: Look at the pattern of the data points in the scatterplot. Consider how the function $$f(x)=-x$$ might transform the x-values and how this transformation could help fit the data with the given model.

title: Effect of $$f(x)=-x$$
text: If $$f(x)=-x$$, how does this affect the y-values in the model $$y_i=\beta_0+x_i \beta_1+f{\left(x_i\right)} \beta_2$$?
